summary: Rubico Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a warrant inducement agreement with existing holders of Class C warrants to exercise all 7,894,740 warrants at a reduced exercise price from $0.95 to $0.65 per share, generating net proceeds of ~$4.8M. In consideration, holders receive new Class D warrants to purchase up to 15,789,480 common shares at $0.65, expiring in five years, in a private placement. Maxim Group LLC receives a 6% cash fee. This is a financing event, not a special situation. No tender offer, acquisition, or corporate action is involved; it is an ordinary capital raise with warrant repricing.
